options.name: --allow-small-theme
options.description: Waive the minimum size rules for this run.

options.name: --analyze
options.description: Measure a theme file and write the report beside it.

options.name: --ascii
options.description: Force an ASCII slug, whatever it costs the words.

options.name: --casing
options.description: kebab, snake or camel.

options.name: --clipboard
options.description: Copy each generated slug to the clipboard.

options.name: --count
options.description: How many slugs one round generates.

options.name: --fold-accents
options.description: Drop the diacritic from a letter that carries one.

options.name: --init
options.description: Save the options of this command line as the defaults, and quit.

options.name: --list-themes
options.description: List the themes in scope and quit.

options.name: --max-length
options.description: The most characters a slug may carry. Narrows what the run draws from; never truncates.

options.name: --max-segment-words
options.description: The most words any one drawn value may carry, or  'none'. Narrows what the run draws from; never splits a value.  'none' overrides a cap the drawn theme's own defaults would  otherwise apply.

options.name: --mimic-style
options.description: Whether the drawn theme's own defaults apply. On its  own, means true.

options.name: --oneshot
options.description: Generate once and quit, instead of staying in the REPL.

options.name: --register
options.description: Validate a theme file and copy it into the theme  directory.

options.name: --seed
options.description: Seed for a reproducible run.

options.name: --segment
options.description: What sits in front of the noun: adjective, participle,  either, both or threeOrTwo.

options.name: --sep
options.description: What joins the slug's terms. A single character.

options.name: --theme
options.description: Theme to draw from. Repeatable, accepts a comma-separated  list, and '*' for every theme in scope.

options.name: --theme-dir
options.description: Where registered themes live, instead of the default  directory.

options.name: --theme-info
options.description: Show a theme's own metadata - title, description,  version, author, source - and quit.

options.name: --token-chance
options.description: How often the token appears, 0 to 100.

options.name: --token-glued
options.description: Glue the token to the previous segment, with no  separator.

options.name: --token-hex
options.description: Draw the token in hexadecimal rather than decimal.

options.name: --token-length
options.description: Length of the trailing token. 0 for none.

options.name: --unregister
options.description: Remove a registered theme.

options.name: --word-sep
options.description: What joins the words of a compound value. A single  character, or nothing to glue them.
